title: Pinned service upgrade and recovery hardening
question: Can the pinned Postiz upgrade preserve production delivery while improving reproducibility, startup and tested recovery?
hypotheses: Integrating v2.25.0 with preserved DappGo receipts and versioned Temporal workflows is release-compatible.
Pinned images and evidence-preserving retention prevent repeat drift without another control layer.
Isolated database restore and existing gateway fallback prove recovery without production migration.
acceptance_criteria: Pinned Postiz v2.25.0 preserves receipts, provider fixes and existing Temporal histories.
Selected runtime images have reproducible digest identities.
Startup bundle optimization passes compatibility and measured startup checks.
Workload retention preserves diagnostic evidence before bounded deletion.
Existing gateway fallback and isolated database restore pass without production data changes.
Selective release and affected health checks pass; completed own worktrees are cleaned.
evidence: Owner authorized items 1-5 and confirmed recommended isolated recovery scope; no production publication or Bastion deletion.
